1.title: Charlie Kirk murder suspect told roommate 'he wishes he hadn't done it', court hears
1.summary: The court hears an investigative interview with the suspect's ex-roommate and romantic partner and reveals their texts.

2.title: With Graham Platner's exit from Senate race looming, Democrats line up to replace him
2.summary: Democrats in Maine are already competing to get their name on the ballot and take on incumbent Republican Senator Susan Collins in November.

3.title: What to know about 'explosive diarrhoea' parasite outbreak in US
3.summary: The source of the cyclosporiasis outbreak, which has spread across at least 17 states, is unclear.

4.title: Live Updates: U.S. and Iran Sink Into Violent Cycle After Latest Strikes
4.summary: As Iranians buried their slain leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, prospects for a long-term peace deal appeared to be dimming.

5.title: US and Iran trade attacks as Khamenei is buried
5.summary: Centcom says it hit 90 Iranian targets in the latest round of strikes, with the Iranian health ministry saying 14 people were killed since Tuesday.

6.title: Gaza Aid Worker on His Way to Watch World Cup Killed by Israeli Strike
6.summary: The Israeli military said it had struck a Hamas militant but was aware of reports that “uninvolved civilians” were harmed.
